title: Homemade Pineapple Juice for Cough
description: A fresh pineapple, ginger and lemon drink with optional honey. Enjoy it as a beverage; pineapple juice has not been shown to treat a cough.
author: Better Sweet Drinks
ingredients: 1 medium ripe pineapple, peeled and chopped
1 inch fresh ginger, peeled (use less to taste)
1 tablespoon honey (optional; never for children under 12 months)
Cold water or ice, as needed to blend
instructions:
1. Blend pineapple, ginger and lemon juice, adding a little cold water if needed.
  2. Strain if desired.
  3. Stir in optional honey and salt to taste; serve chilled.
notes: Serve fresh and refrigerate promptly. Pineapple juice is not a proven cough treatment. Honey may help cough symptoms for adults and children at least one year old; never give honey to infants under 12 months.
keywords: pineapple juice, pineapple ginger drink, lemon pineapple juice
